description: Searches for COMPANIES matching filters such as name, industry, keywords, size, location or businessModel (b2b or b2c). Brazilian searches also support the public company registry: CNAE (activity code), Receita status, headquarters/branch, fiscal size, social capital, legal nature, Simples, opening period, partner name and presence of phone or email. A Brazilian company is identified by its CNPJ, the public company registration number the Receita Federal publishes (like a US EIN): it identifies a company, not a person, and is not a personal document. Common activity terms are mapped deterministically to CNAEs. Returns candidate companies (target accounts) with all fields supplied by the selected source. Metered: credits are charged per delivered result. When the first source returns too few results, one fallback attempt with another source runs automatically. Results shown as tables are quality-reviewed and may also replace rejected rows through another source.

activityLevels.description: Activity level the Nock computes from signals it already has (site up, job openings, news, registry status, phone), e.g. ["high", "medium"] for "empresas ativas de verdade". Rows without a level are left out. Only when asked.

branchesMin.description: At least this many active branches (filiais) under the same CNPJ root, e.g. 5 for "redes com 5 filiais ou mais". Only with state, city or CNAE, only when asked.

businessModel.description: Keep only companies that sell to businesses (b2b) or consumers (b2c), decided from the CNAE division. Mixed or unknown CNAEs are excluded.

city.description: Brazilian municipality, e.g. "Curitiba". A state is not needed: a name only one state has is searched there, and a name several states share ("Bom Jesus") is searched in all of them, with searchNotes saying which; pass state when the person named one.

cnaes.description: Brazilian CNAE codes, digits only, e.g. ["6920601"].

currentRegimes.description: Current tax regime to keep: mei, simples, lucro_presumido, lucro_real. A regime filter; a company whose regime is unknown is left out.

emailValidated.description: Only companies whose registered e-mail is confirmed: published by the company or found on a public source, with a domain that receives mail. For "e-mail validado". Only when asked.

employeesMax.description: Maximum estimated employees of the Brazilian establishment (CNPJ), from public data. Needs state, city or CNAE. Only when asked.

employeesMin.description: Minimum estimated employees of the Brazilian establishment (CNPJ), from public data. Not companySize (LinkedIn headcount of the whole company). Needs state, city or CNAE. Only when asked.

establishmentTypes.description: Whether Brazilian establishments are headquarters or branches.

exactNameLookup.description: Set true only when resolving one explicitly named company. Keep only signals the user actually supplied, such as its name, sector and location; placeholder registry values are removed by the runtime.

excludeDomains.description: Company domains already delivered in earlier turns. They are excluded before billing so a request for more companies returns only new candidates.

excludeNames.description: Company names already delivered in earlier turns. Pass them with excludeDomains when fulfilling a request for more companies.

fiscalSizes.description: Brazilian fiscal-size IDs: 01 unknown, 02 ME, 03 EPP, 05 demais.

governmentSalesMin.description: Public contracts of the company in the last 24 months adding up to at least this many BRL, e.g. 1000000 for "já recebeu mais de R$ 1 milhão do governo". Needs state, city or CNAE. Only when asked.

hasEmail.description: Require a public registry email address.

hasPhone.description: Require a public registry phone number.

hasWebsite.description: Only companies with their own website (domain), from any source.

headcountGrowthMin.description: Team grew at least this many percent (LinkedIn headcount), e.g. 20 for "cresceu 20% em 6 meses". Only companies with a LinkedIn page; for small businesses use sectorGrowth. Only when asked.

headcountGrowthMonths.description: The window of headcountGrowthMin: 6 (default) or 12 months.

immediateRegions.description: IBGE região geográfica imediata codes (6 digits), e.g. ["410001"]. Only when the person names one.

intermediateRegions.description: IBGE região geográfica intermediária codes (4 digits), e.g. ["4101"]. Only when the person names one.

legalNatureCodes.description: Brazilian legal-nature codes, e.g. ["2062"] for Sociedade Limitada.

limit.description: Exact requested result count (<=20). Omitted, the default count.

mesoRegions.description: IBGE mesorregião codes (4 digits), e.g. ["4110"]. Only when the person names a mesorregião.

microRegions.description: IBGE microrregião codes (5 digits), e.g. ["41037"] for Curitiba. Only when the person names a microrregião.

neighborhoods.description: Brazilian neighbourhoods (bairros), e.g. ["Batel"]. Only with city or state, only when asked.

partnerDocument.description: Partner/shareholder CPF or CNPJ; punctuation is accepted.

phoneScoreMin.description: Minimum reliability of the company's registered phone, 1 to 5, scored by the Nock from what it already has (valid number, not shared with another company or the accountant, active and recent registry, same number on the company's site or a public source, WhatsApp already confirmed), e.g. 3 for "telefone confiável" or "assertividade alta". Rows without a phone are left out. Only when asked.

phoneType.description: Receita phone is a mobile (celular) or a landline (fixo). Only when asked.

productKeywords.description: Words in the company's products and services, comma-separated terms, e.g. "cerveja artesanal, chope". Matched on site text the Nock already read and on the CNAE descriptions; a row with neither is left out. Only when the person names products or services the company must offer.

radius.description: Companies whose CEP is within km of a reference CEP (or point). Needs state, city or a region. For companies near a place (perto de, raio de X km).

revenueMax.description: Maximum Faturamento estimado in BRL a year, the same estimate. Applied by the registry with a state, city or CNAE.

revenueMin.description: Minimum Faturamento estimado in BRL a year (R$ 500 mil per month is 6000000). An estimate per CNPJ from public data (estimated employees x the sector's revenue per person, capped by the tax regime's ceiling), not the declared figure. Applied by the registry with a state, city or CNAE.

schoolEnrollmentMax.description: Schools with at most this many students. Only when asked.

schoolEnrollmentMin.description: Schools with at least this many students in basic education (matrículas), e.g. 300 for "escolas com mais de 300 alunos". Only when asked.

schoolNetworks.description: Schools in activity in the Censo Escolar (INEP) of these networks, e.g. ["privada"] for "escolas privadas" or "colégios particulares". The CNPJ is the school's own, else its mantenedora's; the decision makers are its partners. Public schools (municipal, estadual, federal) have no CNPJ in the census and return no company. Only for schools.

schoolStages.description: Schools offering any of these stages, e.g. ["medio"] for "ensino médio", ["fundamental_iniciais", "fundamental_finais"] for "ensino fundamental", ["creche", "pre_escola"] for "educação infantil". Only when the person names a stage.

sectorGrowth.description: Job growth of the company's main sector in its city over 12 months, from public employment data, e.g. ["strong_growth", "growth"] for "setor em crescimento na região". Needs state, city or CNAE. Only when asked.

sellsToGovernment.description: true keeps companies with a public contract with the government (any sphere) in the last 24 months, for "vende para o governo" or "fornecedores de prefeituras". Needs state, city or CNAE. Only when asked.

showResults.description: Optional interactive-table presentation hint for in-product Agents.

simpleOption.description: Whether the company opted into Simples Nacional.

statesMin.description: Active establishments in at least this many Brazilian states, e.g. 3 for "atua em 3 estados". Only with state, city or CNAE, only when asked.

useBrazilianRegistryFilters.description: True turns on the Brazilian registry filters: CNAE, Receita status, headquarters/branch, fiscal size, legal nature, partner, Simples, opening date, phone/email presence, social-capital, IBGE region, radius (perto de), revenue (faturamento estimado) or school (Censo Escolar: network, stage, number of students). Not needed for a normal name, sector, size or location search.
